name: Dray Nur Waterfall
summary: A curtain about 250 m wide on the Serepok, south of Buon Ma Thuot. The Dak Lak handbook puts it about 30 km out. A news article puts it about 25 km. Allow a half day with the drive. The gate price is Check on arrival.
getThere: About 25 km or about 30 km south by car
heroCaption: The curtain of Dray Nur across the cliff

notice.title: The new price is not printed
notice.body: A 19 Dec 2024 notice from the Dak Lak culture and tourism center changes the ticket and does not print the amount. Read the board. Do not budget only the older 30,000 VND or 50,000 VND figures.

body: The fall is a curtain about 250 m wide on the Serepok, in Krong Ana. Go by car or a tour from town and allow a half day with the drive. The Dak Lak Department of Culture, Sports and Tourism handbook puts it about 30 km south. A news article from the Dak Lak culture and tourism center puts it about 25 km. The minutes are Check on arrival. Swim only where the staff allow it. The rock is slippery.

The gate price is Check on arrival. The handbook prints 30,000 VND to enter and 50,000 VND for a combo with Gia Long. The news article cites 50,000 VND. The Dak Lak Department of Justice fee schedule prints 30,000 VND as the adult default for a scenic site. The 19 Dec 2024 notice announces a new price and does not print the amount. Rainy-season volume is why some people wait, and those months are Check on arrival.

figures.caption: A closer stretch of the fall, with mist at the base
figures.alt: Water pouring over the Dray Nur cliff, with leaves in front and mist below

gettingThere: Dray Nur is on the Serepok in Krong Ana, south of Buon Ma Thuot. The handbook distance is about 30 km. The culture and tourism center news article says about 25 km. Both stay. Go by car or a tour. The minutes and the fare are Check on arrival.

legs.heading: From Buon Ma Thuot
legs.body: Car or tour from the city center. No minute count is printed for the 25 km figure or the 30 km figure. The minutes are Check on arrival.

closed: No weekly closing day is printed. Check the gate board on arrival.
